desc.zh: 从字符重叠到子集与末尾单词，重建全局最短超级串。
desc.en: Turn word overlaps into subset-and-endpoint states and reconstruct a shortest superstring.

complexity: O(n²L² + n²2ⁿ) time; O(n2ⁿ + n² + nL) auxiliary space, where L is maximum word length

concepts.name: Subset and endpoint DP
concepts.description: Keep the minimum chain length for each selected subset and last word; reconstruct with predecessor pointers.
